drug_information.description: Mephedrone (4-Methylmethcathinone) is a synthetic psychoactive substance classified as a psychotropic substance under the NDPS framework. Unauthorized possession, manufacture, sale, transport, storage and distribution are prohibited.

applicable_ndps_sections.title: Prohibition of Certain Operations
applicable_ndps_sections.applicability: Prohibits unauthorized possession, manufacture, sale, purchase, transport, storage, use and related operations involving narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances.

applicable_ndps_sections.title: Punishment for Contravention in Relation to Psychotropic Substances
applicable_ndps_sections.applicability: Applies to offences involving psychotropic substances, with punishment depending on the applicable quantity category.

storage_guidelines: Store in tamper-evident sealed evidence bags.
Label each exhibit with a unique evidence ID.
investigation_guidelines: Secure the scene and prevent contamination.
Photograph and document seized materials before handling.
Collect representative samples following applicable NDPS procedures.
Maintain an unbroken chain of custody.
Record weight, packaging and identifying marks.
Document witness statements and seizure documentation.
Send representative samples to an authorized forensic laboratory.
officer_precautions: Avoid direct contact with unknown substances.
